description: Log Analytics alert rules for SecondWave landing zone security monitoring.

alerts.name: Firewall-Denied-Connections-High
alerts.description: High volume of denied outbound connections from Azure Firewall - possible data exfiltration or malware C2.
alerts.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category == 'AzureFirewallNetworkRule' | where action_s == 'Deny' | summarize DeniedCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | where DeniedCount > 100

alerts.name: KeyVault-Access-Anomaly
alerts.description: Unusual Key Vault access pattern - potential credential theft or privilege escalation.
alerts.query: AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceType == 'VAULTS' | where OperationName in ('VaultPurge', 'VaultDelete', 'VaultUndelete') | project TimeGenerated, OperationName, CallerIPAddress, Identity, ResourceId

alerts.name: Policy-Non-Compliance-Critical
alerts.description: Critical resources are non-compliant with Azure Policy - immediate investigation required.
alerts.query: AzureActivity | where CategoryValue == 'Policy' | where OperationNameValue contains 'nonCompliant' | where _ResourceId contains '/kv-platform-' or _ResourceId contains '/afw-' | project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, PolicyDefinitionName

alerts.name: NSG-Internet-Ingress
alerts.description: Inbound traffic from internet detected on workload NSG - potential misconfiguration or attack.
alerts.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category == 'NetworkSecurityGroupFlowEvent' | where flowStatus_s == 'A' | where flowDirection_s == 'I' | where sourceIP_s !startswith '10.' | summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | where Count > 10

alerts.name: Bastion-Audit-Failures
alerts.description: Failed Bastion authentication attempts - possible brute-force attack on management plane.
alerts.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category == 'BastionAuditLogs' | where OperationName contains 'Failed' | summarize FailureCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), CallerIPAddress | where FailureCount > 5
